name: PdxTimeline
description: A vertical or horizontal sequence of events, with status colors, icons and clickable items.

members.name: pending
members.description: Shows a pending node at the end.

members.name: pendingLabel
members.description: The pending row's text. Empty: the timeline.pending component string.

members.name: mode
members.description: Where the events sit: beside the line, on the right of it, both sides in turn, or in a row.

members.name: connectorStyle
members.description: How the connector between the dots is drawn.

members.name: dotAlign
members.description: Where a dot sits against its event's content.

events.name: pdx-click
events.description: A clickable event was clicked, or pressed with Enter or Space.

attributes.name: pending
attributes.description: Shows a pending node at the end.

attributes.name: pendinglabel
attributes.description: The pending row's text. Empty: the timeline.pending component string.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: Where the events sit: beside the line, on the right of it, both sides in turn, or in a row.

attributes.name: connectorstyle
attributes.description: How the connector between the dots is drawn.

attributes.name: dotalign
attributes.description: Where a dot sits against its event's content.

slots.name: content
slots.description: Renders the content of one entry: a snippet `content(item, index)`.

cssParts.name: track
cssParts.description: The column of an event's line and dot.

cssParts.name: line
cssParts.description: The connector, drawn as the axis `connector-style` says.

cssParts.name: dot
cssParts.description: The event's dot, with its icon when it has one.

cssParts.name: content
cssParts.description: The event's text, or the `content` snippet.

cssStates.name: pending
cssStates.description: `pending`: a last row says more is to come.

cssStates.name: clickable
cssStates.description: `clickable`: each event is a tab stop, and a click or Enter emits `pdx-click`.
